case_title: Roopendra Singh v. State of Tripura & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused was tried for committing offences punishable under Sections 342, 376(2)(b), and 506 of the Indian Penal Code. The trial court acquitted the accused of all charges. The victim, who was the widow of the deceased, challenged the acquittal by filing a criminal appeal under Section 372 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The High Court initially allowed the appeal without requiring leave, but the Supreme Court later remanded the matter to the High Court for reconsideration in light of the decision in Satya Pal Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh. The Supreme Court set aside the High Court's order and directed that the appeal be considered on merits.
